blocks.text: Grace Lee beamed with gratitude as she announced her pregnancy with her first child at 43, two years after tying the knot with her non-showbiz husband Alex Tiu. The former TV host and disc jockey made the announcement through her Instagram page last Saturday, Oct. 24, while showing moments from her recent baby shower. “Awaiting the arrival of our baby boy,” she revealed in the caption. “Blessed to be pregnant at 43!
